Lessons.Title: Matrices and Matrix Operations
ExplanationParagraphs: Describe matrices by dimensions and entries.
Matrix multiplication uses row-by-column dot products.
Matrix products need matching inner dimensions.
A matrix power B^n requires square B.
Independent Cool-down: demonstrate a valid example of the section's central operation and check exact answer.

KeyConcepts.Title: Mathematical validity
KeyConcepts.Definition: Operations follow matrix dimensions and algebraic identities.

SummaryPoints: Describe matrices by dimensions and entries.

CommonMistakes.Mistake: Ignore matrix dimension, rank or determinant restrictions.
CommonMistakes.WhyWrong: May produce undefined operation or false unique solution.
CommonMistakes.Correction: Inspect dimensions and singularity; check original equations.
